acquisition_method: A data dependent mass spectrometric method was employed, where the 10 most intense ions, excluding unassigned charge states and singly charged ions, detected in the preceding full scan are isolated (3 Th isolation width) and fragmented using higher energy collisional dissociation (HCD) (normalized collision energy 25).
alkylation_concentration: After reduction (5 mM DTT, 30 min) and alkylation (10 mM iodoacetamide, 20 min, in the dark), proteins were digested for 3 h by Lys-C (Wako) at a protein:enzyme ratio of 100:1.
alkylation_reagent: After reduction (5 mM DTT, 30 min) and alkylation (10 mM iodoacetamide, 20 min, in the dark), proteins were digested for 3 h by Lys-C (Wako) at a protein:enzyme ratio of 100:1.
cleavage_agent: proteins were digested for 3 h by Lys-C (Wako) at a protein:enzyme ratio of 100:1... prior to overnight trypsin digestion (Sequencing grade, Promega) at a protein:enzyme ratio of 100:1.
collision_energy: fragmented using higher energy collisional dissociation (HCD) (normalized collision energy 25).
fractionation_method: Peptides (180 μg) were separated by in-solution isoelectric focusing (OFFGEL fractionator, Agilent) into 12 fractions over a pH range of 3–10.
fragmentation_method: fragmented using higher energy collisional dissociation (HCD) (normalized collision energy 25).
instrument: Of the resolubilized peptide solution, 6 10 μl were subsequently analyzed by liquid chromatography (LC) using an EASY nLC-II coupled to a Q Exactive mass spectrometer (Thermo Scientific, Bremen, Germany).
